text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kita! So today's the big day—it's
your
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Teio, one more time! Say that
again, just
one more time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That was my dream. I've always wanted
you to
remember my birthday...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's like my dad said. You'll know you've
made it
when your hero remembers you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Until they celebrate with you in some way, you're just another nobody. But today, you wished me a happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm... yeah, that's right. You've finally
gained my
attention, so I remembered
your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But you shouldn't stop here, got it?
You've gotta
keep getting better and
become my rival
someday.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Teio... hearing that from
you is
the greatest gift of all. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Haha, I can't tell her that I've had it
memorized
for a long time now. Geez,
should I still give her
the karaoke mic I
bought?)
